reviews.title: A Massive Upgrade for My PC
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] I upgraded from the 990 Pro 2TB to the 9100 Pro 4TB with heatsink, and the difference is immediately noticeable. Load times are even faster, file transfers feel instant, and overall system responsiveness took a clear step up. The built-in heatsink is a big plus—it keeps temperatures stable under heavy workloads without needing extra cooling. Installation was simple, and it’s been rock solid so far. If you’re coming from a high-end SSD already and want a real upgrade, this drive delivers.
